question.text: An AIF distributor's good-practice obligations include:

answer.text: Only the investor's PAN card copy
Only the subscription agreement signed by the investor

Formulating a customer-specific risk profile, providing risk and fee disclosures via a distribution kit, assisting KYC and transaction paperwork, maintaining distribution infrastructure, and ensuring suitability
Only the commission receipts from the fund house

explanation.text: The Logic: The Series XIX-A workbook (pages 167 and 270-278) lists distributor good practices as: formulating a customer-specific risk profile/questionnaire, providing risk and fee disclosures through a distribution kit, assisting investors with KYC and transaction paperwork, maintaining adequate distribution infrastructure, and ensuring suitability of the product to the investor. The Trap: KYC documents (PAN) and subscription agreements are necessary but insufficient. Commission receipts are internal records, not distributor good-practice obligations. Note: Investment-rationale records appear on page 211, but those are Manager/Sponsor records, not distributor-maintained records. Keep the distributor scope as stated in the workbook.
